artifact: PHASE 4D REMEDIATION §1, §2, §5, §6, §7 - each reported defect reproduced against the failed baseline, then re-run against the remediation

defects.title: aggregate consumption against one capacity
defects.rootCause: every CONSUME_CAPACITY was measured against the same pre-transaction Phase-4C state; the effects never saw one another

defects.title: aggregate consumption across a quantified shared pool
defects.rootCause: same independent-measurement defect, observed through the shared constraint

defects.title: competing ledger successors for one historical usage

preFix.arbitraryWinner: Array.prototype.find picked the first match when rebuilding the ledger

defects.rootCause: no check that two effects claimed the same predecessor; the post-state rebuild resolved it by array order

defects.title: conflicting event assignments resolved by effect-id order

preFix.mechanism: overlay.ts sorted event effects by effectId and wrote them into a Map, so the last write won

defects.rootCause: map overwrite keyed by event description and as-of, with no agreement check

defects.title: dependency on a non-existent effect silently ignored
defects.rootCause: a dangling dependency was treated as a no-op rather than a malformed transaction

defects.title: duplicate effect identity
defects.note: already refused at the failed baseline by classifyEffects; re-asserted here so it stays refused

additionalFindings.title: post-state was never validated against the transaction-level verdict
additionalFindings.detail: the failed baseline computed a post-state and published it without reading what Phase 4C said about it. In the single-capacity case Phase 4C degraded the entry to REVIEW_REQUIRED with an OVER_CONSUMPTION limitation and WITHHELD the remaining figure; the simulation still reported SATISFIED and committable. A sign test on `remaining` alone would have missed this, because the withheld figure is not negative - it is absent.

additionalFindings.title: a metric adjustment was visible to every effect regardless of position
additionalFindings.detail: the overlay was built once from all CHANGE_METRIC effects before any effect ran, so stating an adjustment after a draw had the same effect as stating it before. Ordering is now semantic and both orders are distinguished.

additionalFindings.title: batch reclassification conservation was briefly broken during remediation and restored
additionalFindings.detail: an intermediate sequential design applied each election through its own Phase-4C transition, which let two elections that individually fit jointly exceed the source. Caught by the pre-existing matrix case AE. Elections now execute as ONE Phase-4C batch at the position of the first election, preserving the recertified conservation rule.

additionalFindings.title: the aggregate post-state backstop did not fire in any swept composition
additionalFindings.detail: INSUFFICIENT_AGGREGATE_CAPACITY is implemented and wired, but across 104 swept compositions the sequential model caught every over-draw at the draw itself, reporting INSUFFICIENT_CAPACITY. The backstop is defence in depth, not the mechanism, and is reported as such rather than claimed as coverage.
